title: Transport of derived evaluation to the ordinary quotient model
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y and n≥0. For a cochain complex P of completed ordinary modules on Y, let C=ordinaryReduction(Y)cx(P), κ=pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex(Y,n).inv_P, I=intrinsic finite pullback, V=finite derived pullback, τ=pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic(f,n), and S=ordinary sequence inverse image. Write facG for the canonical exact-functor localization comparison Gderived(QK)→Q(Gcx(K)). Then pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation(f,n).hom_(QC), followed by V(facEvalY(C)≫Qκ) and facI(scalarExt(Y,n)cx(P)), equals EvalXderived(facS(C)), followed by facEvalX(Scx(C)), Q(pullbackTensorInverseEvaluationComplex(f,n).inv_C≫levelPull(f,n)cx(κ)), and Q(τcx.hom_(scalarExt(Y,n)cx(P))).

source.place: The scalar/pullback comparison on a flat-term K-flat representative in the finite-evaluation argument; Stacks Tags 07A6, 06YY and 0D6E.

proof.text: Use the cochain normalization which uniquely defines pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation on the ordinary reduction complex. Postcompose by the localized inverse ordinary reduction-evaluation isomorphism. Naturality of the intrinsic exact pullback computation map moves this isomorphism through geometric pullback. Naturality of pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic moves its level pullback through the ordinary intrinsic comparison. Functoriality of localization then gives the displayed quotient-coordinate formula.

theorem integralReductionPullEvaluationQuotient {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) :
    letI := sfIntrinsicPullback_additive (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    letI := sfIntrinsicPullback_preservesFiniteLimits (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    letI := sfIntrinsicPullback_preservesFiniteColimits (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    let C := ((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let κ := (pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E Y n).inv.app P
    let I := sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    (pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation l E f n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) ≫
        (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
          ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app C ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map κ) ≫
        I.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          (((scalarReductionExtension l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
      (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).map
          ((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app C) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          (((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((pullbackTensorInverseEvaluationComplex l E f n).inv.app C ≫
            ((integralOperationsLevelPullback l E f n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map κ) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
          (pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic l E f n) (.up ℤ)).hom.app
            (((scalarReductionExtension l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
